title: On injective dimension of the conormal module
summary: Let $Q$ be a Gorenstein local ring, let $I$ be a proper ideal of $Q$, and set $R=Q/I$. We investigate when finite injective dimension of the conormal module $I/I^2$ forces $I$ to be generated by a regular sequence. We prove this implication for every ideal in the linkage class of a complete intersection. When $Q$ is regular, we also establish it under several numerical conditions in terms of the number of generators of $I$ and the type of $R$.
